summary: Amerant Bancorp Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an underwriting agreement dated September 14, 2026 with Raymond James Associates, Inc. for a $50 million offering of 7.00% Senior Notes due 2031, issued under an automatic shelf registration. The offering closed September 17, 2026, yielding approximately $48.4 million in net proceeds after underwriter discount and expenses. The Notes are unsecured and unsubordinated, pay interest semi-annually each March 17 and September 17 beginning March 17, 2027, and mature September 17, 2031. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes, including potential debt repayment and share repurchases. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
